displayIdentity.body: Wisdom is spoken and discerned through the Spirit. We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing. “For who has known the mind of the Lord that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.
displayIdentity.title: Wisdom is spoken and discerned through the Spirit
